_comment: Model policy overrides for PlaceMakers (ai.policyOverrides). The platform's 5-second limit for the two fast steps (reading the customer's intent, choosing a tool) is shorter than the project's answer model, openai/gpt-5.5, usually takes, so the step timed out and fell back. 10 seconds lets it finish. A faster model for those two steps is the better fix: add "model": "<a smaller model your account can use>" to each. Applied by scripts/okf/apply-tenant-release.ts only for policies the project has not overridden itself.
